description: the words of the subsystem rec in the heartbeat rec/heartbeats/<name> that other processes read (open places of the Platform family heartbeats, P/03.4 Н1.1: the top of the heartbeat and an element of status[] beyond the Platform fields); the meaning — V/02.4 Н1.8, V/02.5 Н1.7, V/02.8 Н1.2, V/02.9 Н1.3, Н1.5, Н1.10; the other words of the heartbeat are diagnostics, neither the Platform nor the subsystems read them

volume.description: the held volume (place_by) or "" — holds none (V/02.4 Н1.8)

url.description: the address of the archive door (V/02.5 Н1.7)

ingest.description: the address of the recorder's receiver (V/02.9 Н1.3, Н1.10)

stream.description: the camera stream word in the heartbeat of the card's recorder (V/02.8 Н1.2, V/02.9 Н1.10); other processes read only lagging

written_through.description: up to where the recording is written, closed blocks, seconds by the cluster clock (V/02.4 Н1.8, V/02.9 Н1.3)
